title: China's Retirement Reform and the 2035 Statutory Working-Age Window: Buying Time amid Demographic Decline and AI-Driven Change
summary_en: Using a monthly birth-cohort simulation, the author estimates that China’s 2025 retirement reform keeps about 48 million additional people below statutory retirement ages in 2035, delaying the working-age decline without reversing population aging.
title_cn: China's Retirement Reform and the 2035 Statutory Working-Age Window: Buying Time amid Demographic Decline and AI-Driven Change

title: Interpreting Dual-Use Biology Benchmarks for Frontier AI: Measurement, Saturation, and Generational Analysis
summary_en: The authors find that many artificial intelligence (AI) benchmark tasks are no longer informative, but a frontier of difficult tasks remains so, with recent gains concentrated on difficult tasks theorized to be relevant to real-world risk.
title_cn: Interpreting Dual-Use Biology Benchmarks for Frontier AI: Measurement, Saturation, and Generational Analysis

title: Public Benefits Are a Hidden Engine of College Completion
summary_en: It's often short-run financial constraints—not enough money to cover rent or food while also paying for school—that keep young adults out of the classroom. Public benefits relieve enough pressure to make enrollment possible. Once enrolled, benefits also help students stay.
title_cn: Public Benefits Are a Hidden Engine of College Completion

title: Can AI Change How We Deal with Disasters?
summary_en: How might AI tools help emergency management professionals save lives, protect property, and reduce harm to communities?
title_cn: Can AI Change How We Deal with Disasters?

title: AI and the Future of Emergency Management: Market Supply and Adoption Pathways
summary_en: In this report, the authors present the results of a landscape assessment of artificial intelligence–enabled products that are available to support the work of emergency management across the United States.
title_cn: AI and the Future of Emergency Management: Market Supply and Adoption Pathways

title: Secure Inference Data Centers: A Vertically Integrated Strategy for Security Engineering
summary_en: This report describes the deployment of secure inference data centers (SIDCs)—purpose-built facilities designed to protect artificial intelligence models from advanced nation-state adversaries. SIDCs can be built today with proven technologies.
title_cn: Secure Inference Data Centers: A Vertically Integrated Strategy for Security Engineering

title: The Economics of AI Counterproliferation: A Stylized Economic Framework
summary_en: Once an artificial intelligence (AI) capability has been demonstrated at the frontier, the cost of reproducing it tends to fall. A new RAND economic framework shows the implications for governance regimes of AI capabilities and for policy and strategy.
title_cn: The Economics of AI Counterproliferation: A Stylized Economic Framework
